settings.caption: TIPS AND PANELS
settings.description: Short hints that appear the first time a screen or a warning comes up. Tips you hid stay hidden until you reset them.
settings.panelsDescription: Panels on the galaxy map can be dragged by their title. This puts the units list, the map index and the layers bar back where they started. {ResetMapPanels} does the same on the map.
settings.panelsDone: Panels are back where they started.

tips.title: Galaxy map
tips.text: {MapLayerUp} and {MapLayerDown} change the layer. {MapTilt} tilts the view to show the layers around it. Click a sector to pin its card; right-click one for the course menu.

tips.title: Charted and uncharted
tips.text: Sectors under a veil are uncharted: you can still fly there, but you see nothing of them. Green rings are live sensor range; ships outside them are only last known.

tips.title: Scan the sector
tips.text: Scan sector charts the sector you are in. It takes 5 seconds and flight goes on, but leaving the sector or switching ship cancels it. {ScanSector} does the same from the flight view, and pressing it again during a scan cancels it.

tips.title: Uncharted sector
tips.text: Press {ScanSector} to scan this sector: 5 seconds, flight goes on. Press it again to cancel. Leaving the sector or switching ship cancels it too, and a sector cannot be scanned again for a short while.

tips.title: Command view
tips.text: Left-click selects a ship, drag draws a box, Ctrl adds to the selection. Right-click a place for the course menu. {Follow} puts the camera on the selection, {Halt} stops it.

tips.title: Plot jump or Jump here
tips.text: In the menu, Plot jump sets a course for the ship you fly: aim at the NAV marker and boost. Jump here orders the other selected ships to jump at once. Move here flies without a jump.

tips.title: Sensors and fog
tips.text: Green rings are sensor range and space beyond them is dark. A ship in a ring is live; one outside it shows where it was last seen.

tips.title: Ship editor
tips.text: Pick a part on the left, then left-click a face of the ship to place it. R over a face turns the part. Ctrl+Z undoes, Delete removes the selected block.

tips.title: Apply or cancel
tips.text: Apply rebuilds the ship from your design; warnings never stop it. Cancel, {ToggleEditor} or Esc leaves the ship as it was.

tips.title: Shield down
tips.text: A broken shield takes no hits until its charge builds back to the restart level. It starts to recharge after a delay without damage and draws energy to do so. Point at the shield bar for the figures.

tips.title: Energy is low
tips.text: With an empty battery the shield charges on spare power only and boost will not start. Generation refills the battery; point at the energy bar for the flow.

tips.title: Edit the drone
tips.text: You can also edit the drone: press Ctrl+{ToggleEditor}.
